name: webagent
description: Test your web app in a real cloud browser with Lookover QA (/webagent:qa, /webagent:qa-triage, /webagent:qa-init, /webagent:qa-ci), or drive a browser with your own model through Lookover Browser (/webagent:run). Sign in with Lookover in the browser; no API key needed.

api_key.title: webagent API key (optional)
api_key.description: Optional, for CI / no browser; leave empty to sign in with Lookover (/mcp, plugin:webagent:lookover-qa, Authenticate). A key from the dashboard (API keys, Create key; member role is enough) looks like wa_<region>_... Stored in your system keychain, never in a file.

api_url.title: webagent API URL
api_url.description: API origin without /mcp. Keep the default unless your team gave you another (beta: this is the staging host).
